release_notes: v1.1.7: Saves each new successful dictation's original 16 kHz mono audio as a private local WAV beside its history transcript, with playback in History. Audio is excluded from backups and removed when its history item is deleted, cleared, or evicted; recordings are capped at 120 seconds. Existing history entries have no audio. Optional AI polishing remains text-only. ARM64-only packaging and manual GitHub Releases updates are unchanged.
